title: Munir Zulu and Anor v Attorney General (2025/CCZ/009) [2025] ZMCC 12 (27 June 2025)
case_name: Munir Zulu and Anor v Attorney General
issue_tags: Article 79 - principal and governing law for constitutional amendment
wider public consultations - matter of practice, not requirement
judicial intervention as recommendation for amendment (Isaac Mwanza/Maurice Makalu)
Law Association of Zambia v Attorney General applied
outcome_detail: Petition dismissed; petition should have been handled within ambit of Article 79 (principal and governing law on constitutional amendments); had it been so handled, Article 79 would have been found not contravened; absence of wider public consultations cannot be a basis for nullifying a constitutional amendment process without proof of breach of Article 79; no order as to costs
